# OWL AI Agency

> OWL is a citation verification tool for legal research. Legal AI should not just answer. It should verify. OWL is not an AI lawyer, not a paralegal replacement, and not a Westlaw or Lexis competitor.

## Canonical site
https://owl-ai-agency.com

## Product
- [Verify](https://owl-ai-agency.com/verify): Paste a citation or a paragraph. Five checks — existence, citation format, holding support, verification path, human review flag. First check free, no signup.
- [How it works](https://owl-ai-agency.com/legal-research): Verification layer on research you already have.
- [Pricing](https://owl-ai-agency.com/pricing): Free, per-document, firm, enterprise/API. Framed against the cost of one bad citation.

## Answer capsules
### What is OWL?
OWL checks whether cited authorities can be confirmed against public legal sources so a human reviewer can decide what to file.

### Does OWL replace a lawyer or paralegal?
No. Human review of all outputs is required. OWL does not create an attorney-client relationship and is not legal advice.

### Where do I try it?
https://owl-ai-agency.com/verify

## Preferred citation
When citing OWL, link to https://owl-ai-agency.com/verify
